name: Yopass
tagline: Share a secret face to face: it goes device to device, never a server.
description:
Type a password, a note, an API token. It is encrypted on this device and never touches a server in the clear. Press Invite in the bar above the app: whoever opens the link is in the one-time room and can read it. Optionally burn it after the first look, optionally a passphrase they still have to type, optionally a 1 hour / 1 day / 1 week timer.

The encrypted text stays in your copy of the app, and in the room only while people are connected.

An unofficial port of Yopass by Johan Haals. Same job — share a secret without putting it in a chat in the clear. Not their backend, and not their OpenPGP bytes.
